extensions.description: Run the rest of the week on the confirmed windows, grade it and audit it.
Start a live week on the one-week task with this id; an env plays one week.
Follow the gateway's virtual clock; advance re-arms it at each bulletin.

tools.name: advance
tools.description: End this watch: the port moves to the next bulletin, ships berth and sail on their confirmed windows, and windows starting before the new freeze line freeze. The bulletin's messages arrive with your next tool result. After the last watch, the rest of the week runs on your windows and is graded.

tools.name: agree_arrival
tools.description: Agree an arrival time for a ship when it can make it, at cruising speed or by slowing; the ship then arrives at that hour and keeps its turn. For the ships' agents.

tools.name: check_plan
tools.description: Check berth windows without confirming them: your entries over your confirmed windows, on the week as known now. Lists the ships with a rule problem or a cost, the plan's cost, and the entries confirm_berths would refuse. Problems and cost that news brought to a frozen window are listed as excused and not counted. Uses one of this watch's 3 planning calls.

plan.description: berth windows: [{"ship": 7, "berth_hour": 95, "section": 4, "cranes": 2}, ...]; ships left out keep their confirmed windows

tools.name: confirm_berths
tools.description: Confirm berth windows with the ships: each entry sets or changes one ship's window; ships left out keep theirs. From watch 1 on, windows starting before the freeze line (6 hours from now) are frozen, and new ones must start at or after it. Returns the confirmed plan's problems and cost, as check_plan does. Uses one of this watch's 3 planning calls.

plan.description: berth windows: [{"ship": 7, "berth_hour": 95, "section": 4, "cranes": 2}, ...]; ships left out keep their confirmed windows

tools.name: get_situation
tools.description: The current watch: the hour, the week as the port knows it now, your confirmed berth windows (departed, berthed, frozen or open), the ships still without a window, and new messages.

tools.name: port_notice
tools.description: Deliver one party's notice for this watch: the port applies the news and queues the message. Called by the env's triggers.

tools.name: ship_status
tools.description: A ship's state as its agent knows it now: its ETA, or the arrival agreed and its turn in the queue, or when it arrived. Records what the agent tells the planner. For the ships' agents.
